ModMetaData.name: RimWorld Together
ModMetaData.author: Nova and Company
ModMetaData.description:
Ever wondered how would it be to be able to play with tons of other players, online, in the same RimWorld planet?
 "RimWorld Together" is a community project founded by people who want to push the idea further!
 Build colonies, form alliances, cooperate as a team, raid your enemies, sabotage your neighbors... The list only gets longer!
 Your usual RimWorld experience, with a twist of multiplayer! What are you waiting for? Play, Together!
